parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs indicated for chronic kidney disease. Join drug_indication on mesh_heading or efo_term matching the disease concept. Join molecule_dictionary via molregno to obtain chembl_id and pref_name. Join compound_structures via molregno to obtain canonical_smiles as an INNER JOIN. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
